notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content: Fixed a bug in the achievements that were not being unlocked!

notes.title: Upgrades and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Upgrades[/h1]
[olist]
[*]  Some interactions have been added, at certain levels, to give more depth to the plot!
[*] We added a level selector! You will see it, in the top corner of the menu, after finishing the game!
[*]  We added faded and blurred images to facilitate the completion of the levels. These images are in the background of their respective level.
[*]  We added an option to clear the game progress. This option is in the menu settings.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] A cutscene song that was muted.
[*] Some values ​​saved in the game were deleted after a game over!
[*] At level 3, there was a problem with the scanner.
[/list]

[b]Warnnigs[/b]
[list]
[*] If you already started the game before the upgrade, you will not see your gameplay performance at the end of the game, if you update the game in the middle of the game!
[*] If you have already completed the game before the update, you will not see the level selector in the menu. If it is your case, if you do not want to do everything again to have access to the selector, contact via e-mail; parablesgames@outlook.com
[/list]
